tax_year.rationale: Tax year is encoded in the MeF submission header/form metadata, not as a standalone leaf element in the IRS1040ScheduleC XSD.

taxpayer_name.rationale: ProprievtorNm maps directly to the proprietor name printed at the top of Schedule C.

ssn.rationale: SSN corresponds to the taxpayer's Social Security Number at the top of the form.

principal_business_or_profession.rationale: PrincipalBusinessActivityDesc maps to Line A, the free-text description of the principal business activity.

business_code.rationale: PrincipalBusinessActivityCd maps to Line B, the six-digit activity code.

business_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt maps to Line C, the business name if different from the taxpayer's name.

employer_id_number.rationale: EIN maps to Line D, the Employer Identification Number.

business_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles street/city/state/zip into one string; canonical splits into BusinessUSAddress/AddressLine1Txt + AddressLine2Txt + CityNm + StateAbbreviationCd + ZIPCd (or foreign equivalents) — blueprint should be refactored into separate address component fields.

accounting_method.rationale: Blueprint uses a single category field; canonical schema splits Line F into three separate boolean indicators (MethodOfAccountingCashInd, MethodOfAccountingAccrualInd, MethodOfAccountingOtherInd) — blueprint should be refactored to match or map each category value to the corresponding indicator.

accounting_method_other.rationale: @methodOfAccountingOtherDesc is the attribute holding the description when 'Other' accounting method is selected.

material_participation.rationale: MaterialParticipationInCYInd maps to Line G, the material participation checkbox.

started_or_acquired_in_tax_year.rationale: NewBusinessInCurrentYearInd maps to Line H, whether the business was started or acquired in the current year.

made_payments_requiring_1099.rationale: PaymentRqrFilingForm1099Ind maps to Line I, whether the business made payments requiring a 1099.

required_1099s_filed.rationale: RequiredForm1099FiledInd maps to Line J, whether required 1099 forms were filed.

gross_receipts_or_sales.rationale: TotalGrossReceiptsAmt maps to Part I Line 1, gross receipts or sales.

returns_and_allowances.rationale: ReturnsAndAllowancesAmt maps to Part I Line 2, returns and allowances.

net_receipts.rationale: NetGrossReceiptsAmt maps to Part I Line 3, net receipts after subtracting returns and allowances.

cost_of_goods_sold.rationale: CostOfGoodsSoldAmt maps to Part I Line 4, cost of goods sold carried from Part III.

gross_profit.rationale: GrossProfitAmt maps to Part I Line 5, gross profit.

other_income.rationale: OtherIncomeAmt maps to Part I Line 6, other business income.

gross_income.rationale: GrossIncomeAmt maps to Part I Line 7, gross income total.

advertising.rationale: AdvertisingAmt maps to Part II Line 8, advertising expenses.

car_and_truck_expenses.rationale: CarAndTruckExpensesAmt maps to Part II Line 9, car and truck expenses.

commissions_and_fees.rationale: CommissionsAndFeesAmt maps to Part II Line 10, commissions and fees.

contract_labor.rationale: ContractLaborAmt maps to Part II Line 11, contract labor.

depletion.rationale: DepletionAmt maps to Part II Line 12, depletion expense.

depreciation_and_section_179.rationale: DeprecAndSect179ExpnsDedAmt maps to Part II Line 13, depreciation and Section 179 deduction.

employee_benefit_programs.rationale: EmployeeBenefitProgramAmt maps to Part II Line 14, employee benefit programs.

insurance_other_than_health.rationale: InsuranceAmt maps to Part II Line 15, insurance other than health.

interest_mortgage.rationale: MortgageInterestPaidBanksAmt maps to Part II Line 16a, mortgage interest paid to banks.

interest_other.rationale: MortgageInterestPaidOtherAmt maps to Part II Line 16b, other interest expense.

legal_and_professional_fees.rationale: LegalAndProfessionalServiceAmt maps to Part II Line 17, legal and professional services.

office_expense.rationale: OfficeExpensesAmt maps to Part II Line 18, office expenses.

pension_and_profit_sharing.rationale: PensionProfitSharingPlansAmt maps to Part II Line 19, pension and profit-sharing plans.

rent_lease_vehicles_machinery.rationale: MachineryAndEquipmentRentAmt maps to Part II Line 20a, rent/lease of vehicles, machinery, and equipment.

rent_lease_other_property.rationale: OtherBusinessPropertyRentAmt maps to Part II Line 20b, rent/lease of other business property.

repairs_and_maintenance.rationale: RepairsAndMaintenanceAmt maps to Part II Line 21, repairs and maintenance.

supplies.rationale: SuppliesAmt maps to Part II Line 22, supplies not in cost of goods sold.

taxes_and_licenses.rationale: TaxesAndLicensesAmt maps to Part II Line 23, taxes and licenses.

travel.rationale: TravelAmt maps to Part II Line 24a, travel expenses.

meals.rationale: MealsAndEntertainmentAmt maps to Part II Line 24b, deductible meals.

utilities.rationale: UtilitiesAmt maps to Part II Line 25, utility expenses.

wages.rationale: WagesLessEmploymentCreditsAmt maps to Part II Line 26, wages less employment credits.

other_expenses_total.rationale: TotalOtherExpensesAmt maps to Part II Line 27b, total other expenses from Part V.

total_expenses.rationale: TotalExpensesAmt maps to Part II Line 28, total of all expenses.

tentative_profit_or_loss.rationale: TentativeProfitOrLossAmt maps to Part II Line 29, tentative profit or loss.

home_office_deduction.rationale: HomeBusinessExpenseAmt maps to Part II Line 30, home office expense deduction.

net_profit_or_loss.rationale: NetProfitOrLossAmt maps to Line 31, net profit or loss.

all_investment_at_risk.rationale: AllInvestmentIsAtRiskInd maps to Line 32a, all investment at risk indicator.

some_investment_not_at_risk.rationale: SomeInvestmentIsNotAtRiskInd maps to Line 32b, some investment not at risk indicator.

inventory_method.rationale: Blueprint uses a single category field; canonical schema splits Part III Line 33 into separate boolean indicators (ClosingInventoryCostMethodInd, LowerOfCostOrMarketMethodInd, OtherClosingInventoryMethodInd) — blueprint should be refactored into separate boolean fields per method.

inventory_change_conforms_to_gaap.rationale: ChangeInValuationsInd maps to Part III Line 34, whether there was a change in inventory valuation method.

inventory_beginning_of_year.rationale: BeginningOfYearInventoryAmt maps to Part III Line 35, beginning of year inventory.

purchases_minus_withdrawals.rationale: PurchasesLessPersonalItemsAmt maps to Part III Line 36, purchases less personal withdrawals.

cost_of_labor.rationale: CostOfLaborAmt maps to Part III Line 37, cost of labor in COGS.

materials_and_supplies_cogs.rationale: MaterialsAndSuppliesAmt maps to Part III Line 38, materials and supplies included in COGS.

other_costs_cogs.rationale: OtherCostsAmt maps to Part III Line 39, other costs included in COGS.

total_cogs_before_closing_inventory.rationale: TotalCostsAmt maps to Part III Line 40, total goods available for sale before subtracting closing inventory.

inventory_end_of_year.rationale: EndOfYearInventoryAmt maps to Part III Line 41, end of year inventory.

cost_of_goods_sold_line_42.rationale: CostOfGoodsSoldAmt is also used for Part I Line 4; it represents the same value carried from Part III Line 42, so this is the correct element but it is shared between both blueprint fields.

vehicle_date_placed_in_service.rationale: VehiclePlacedInServiceDt maps to Part IV Line 43, the date the vehicle was placed in service.

vehicle_total_miles.rationale: No canonical element exists for total miles driven; the schema only records business miles (BusinessMilesCnt), commuting miles (CommutingMilesCnt), and other miles (OtherMilesCnt) separately — total must be derived by summing those three fields.

vehicle_business_miles.rationale: BusinessMilesCnt maps to Part IV Line 44a, miles driven for business purposes.

vehicle_commuting_miles.rationale: CommutingMilesCnt maps to Part IV Line 44b, miles driven for commuting.

vehicle_other_miles.rationale: OtherMilesCnt maps to Part IV Line 44c, all other miles driven.

vehicle_available_off_duty.rationale: VehicleAvailableOffDutyHrsInd maps to Part IV Line 45, vehicle available during off-duty hours.

another_vehicle_for_personal_use.rationale: AnotherVehicleForPrsnlUseInd maps to Part IV Line 46, another vehicle available for personal use.

evidence_to_support_deduction.rationale: EvidenceToSupportDeductionInd maps to Part IV Line 47a, whether evidence exists to support the vehicle deduction.

evidence_is_written.rationale: EvidenceWrittenInd maps to Part IV Line 47b, whether the supporting evidence is in written form.

other_expenses.rationale: OtherExpenseDetail is the repeating group element for Part V itemized other expenses; blueprint's array maps to this group rather than a single leaf value, which is the correct structural match.

total_other_expenses.rationale: TotalOtherExpensesAmt maps to Part V Line 48, total other expenses carried to Part II Line 27b.
